en.t: I cannot change my original feelings."

units.source_text: 源氏公子无可奈何，真心怨恨槿姬；

en.t: Prince Genji was helpless, and in his heart he truly resented Princess Asagao;

units.source_text: 但倘就此怀着满腹怨恨而归去，

en.t: but if he were simply to go home full of resentment,

units.source_text: 又觉得像个渔色青年，太不成样子。

en.t: he felt he would look like a young man chasing women, which would be far too unseemly.

units.source_text: 便对宣旨等说：“我今如此受人奚落，

en.t: So he said to Senji and the others, "Now that I have been mocked like this,

units.source_text: 外人知道了定然当作笑柄，

en.t: if outsiders hear of it, they will surely make me a laughingstock,

units.source_text: 你们切不可将此事泄露出去！

en.t: so you must absolutely not let this matter leak out!

units.source_text: 正像古歌所说：‘若有人问答不知，

en.t: It is just as the old poem says: 'If someone asks, answer that you do not know,
I will impose on you without reserve."

units.source_text: 又同她们交头接耳，不知道说些什么。

en.t: Then he whispered with them again, though no one knew what he said.

units.source_text: 但闻侍女们相与谈论：“啊呀，太对人不起了！

en.t: Only the serving women could be heard talking among themselves: "Oh dear, how terribly unfair to him!

units.source_text: 小姐待他如此薄情，真想不到呵！

en.t: Who would have thought our lady would treat him so coldly!

units.source_text: 他并没有轻佻浮薄之相，真冤枉了他。”

en.t: He does not seem frivolous or shallow at all; she has truly misjudged him."
